name: CacheCanary
description: Checks a change for anything that would break Claude prompt caching on Bedrock
about: Point it at a branch or pull request in a project that calls Claude on Amazon Bedrock. It runs the open-source CacheCanary checks on any saved requests, reads the diff for changes that quietly stop prompt caching, and gives one verdict: breaks cache, at risk or safe, with the file and line behind it. It is read-only and never calls AWS.
features: Run CacheCanary on saved Bedrock requests
Spot cache breakers in the code diff
One clear verdict with file and line evidence
examplePrompt: Check my current branch for anything that would break Bedrock prompt caching before I merge.
